title: RAW_UNSCREENED: Wetterbeobachtung versus Kausalnotiz
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: f77r.37 begins teeolain chey and continues with contrasting state/motion forms; it can be an observed weather report or a compact causal explanation.

design.scope_description: Only already exposed f77r text/labels and cached Aristotle I.9-12 source; no new image or selector.
design.mechanism: Report reading records a phenomenon and its observed state; explanation reading marks a condition and consequence under a causal rule.
design.unit: Exact whole-form sequences at named f77r loci.
design.contrast: Descriptive observation register versus causal commentary register
design.prediction: Report predicts stable declarative field order and repeated phenomenon descriptors; explanation predicts conditional framing with a consequent state/action and reuses the same connective function elsewhere.
concrete_observations: GDT936 treats f77r.37 as a conditional candidate and documents chey again at f29v.2; the complete written line retains all seven groups.
linked_consequences: A commentary marker must recur before a consequence-bearing body; a report marker must recur in descriptive field positions without requiring a consequent.
design.nearest_rival: Descriptive observation register versus causal commentary register
design.distinguishing_observation: Compare exact chey positions and the written predicate/state that follows, including f29v.2; do not let German sentence fluency choose the register.
design.strongest_likely_failure: The same chey occurrences lack independently known clause boundaries, so both registers may remain observationally equivalent.
